identity.name: VENUS PIPES & TUBES LTD
identity.industry: HAND-CURATED: Stainless-Steel Pipes & Tubes (import-substitution; metals value-add)

summary.oneLiner: Backward-integrated (Mother Hollow) SS pipe & tube maker now forward-integrating into fittings + spooling/fabrication, riding domestic capex (power/oil-gas/chemicals) and a new high-margin data-center cooling opportunity — full INR200cr+ capex now commissioned, setting up FY27 for >20% growth and a margin climb toward 17–18% by FY28.

thesis (one line): Backward-integrated (Mother Hollow) SS pipe & tube maker now forward-integrating into fittings + spooling/fabrication, riding domestic capex (power/oil-gas/chemicals) and a new high-margin data-center cooling opportunity — full INR200cr+ capex now commissioned, setting up FY27 for >20% growth and a margin climb toward 17–18% by FY28.
scorecard (q4 fy26):
| Metric | Q4 FY26 | Q4 FY25 | YoY | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | INR 302.2 cr | INR 258.1 cr | +17% | FY26 rev INR1,166.8cr, +22% |
| EBITDA | INR 49.4 cr | INR 41.6 cr | +19% | FY26 EBITDA INR190.6cr, +14% |
| EBITDA margin | 16.3% | 16.1% | +20bps | FY26 margin 16.3% |
| EBITDA/ton (blended) | ~INR 65/kg (FY26) | n/d | — | Mgmt gave FY26 blended ~INR65/kg; quarterly not split |
| PAT (reported) | INR 25.4 cr | INR 23.7 cr | +7% | PAT margin 8.4%; ~flat in INR25-26cr range ~9 qtrs |
| PAT (normalized) | ~INR25.4cr | — | — | No material one-offs flagged |
| Volume (MT) | +12-15% YoY (qtr) | — | — | QoQ +1-2%; FY26 vol +~15% |
| Net debt | n/d | n/d | — | NWC ~120 days on sales; EBITDA→CFO conversion 59% (FY26) |

**One-offs:** None flagged. PAT lag vs capex/value-add investment explicitly acknowledged (9 qtrs stuck ~INR25-26cr); mgmt expects PAT to improve as commissioned capex utilizes.

**Volume detail:** FY26 volume growth ~15%; seamless +~18% (rev/vol >15%), welded +~10%. Pricing/realization +5-7% for the year (grade mix effect). QoQ volume only +1-2% (realization broadly flat QoQ).
guidance (critical):
- **Revenue growth FY27:** ">20%" (mgmt frames as conservative given geopolitics; intent to beat). Rough revenue range implied ~INR1,400cr.
- **Volume growth FY27:** >20% on volume front (despite RM price rise of ~5-7%).
- **EBITDA margin:** FY27 to be **higher than FY26's 16.3%**; trajectory toward **17% then 18% (blended) by FY28**. Spooling carries higher margin than base.
- **EBITDA/ton:** FY26 blended ~INR65/kg; no explicit forward number, directionally up with value-add (fittings/spooling).
- **Capex FY27:** INR90-100cr (incl. INR70cr spooling/fabrication facility + maintenance).
- **Capacity:** Welded 27,600 MTPA; Seamless 20,400 MTPA (now 100% backward-integrated via Mother Hollow). Seamless expansion raised from planned 4,800→**6,000 MTPA** (1,800 MT live Nov-2025; 4,200 MT operational on call day). Fittings commissioned. Tandem JCO press added for longer welded pipes.
- **Export mix:** Maintained >30% in FY26; guide 30-35% range to continue. Current order-book export ~40%.
- **Spooling business:** Operational by Dec-2026 (last date; aim earlier). Trial runs Q2 FY27, commercial production mid-Q3 FY27. Asset turn ~3x; NWC similar ~120 days → implied ROCE >25% (at ~20% EBITDA margin per analyst back-calc, mgmt agreed).
demand / pipeline / order book:
- **Order book:** INR450 cr (pipe business) as of Mar-2026 — down ~20% YoY vs ~INR575cr (prior year had large BHEL win). Plus INR185cr data-center LOI + INR50cr BHEL L1 → **~INR685cr total visibility**.
- **Demand sectors (domestic):** power, oil & gas, engineering, chemicals, CNG/PNG; steel-sector capex shifting MS→SS pipe; data centers, semiconductors, solar (new-age).
- **Exports:** Europe strongest (highest volume). US demand seen. Middle East soft due to conflict (Q4 export INR87.8cr vs INR112.5cr Q4FY25). New oil-gas approvals from USA & Middle East received.
- **Good visibility next 2-3 quarters** across Europe, US, domestic.
segment:
- Q4 revenue mix: **Seamless 59% / Welded 34% / Others 7%**.
- Q4 YoY: seamless rev +18%, welded rev +15%.
- Utilization (FY26): seamless ~90-95%; welded ~60-65% (quarter similar). Headroom mainly in welded.
growth / optionality:
- **Mother Hollow backward-integration:** 100% backward-integrated for 20,400 MTPA seamless — insulates from RM volatility, improves supply reliability.
- **Forward integration:** Fittings (commissioned today); spooling/fabrication (INR70cr capex, backed by INR185cr data-center LOI). Among limited integrated players (pipe+fitting+spool) — strong moat.
- **Data-center cooling:** Closed-loop fluid networks for AI/HPC thermal management; SS pipe + fitting + spool; clean-room quality requirement favors reputed players. First reputed pipe player to win such a contract in India. Per-MW spooling content not quantified (varies by DC design; sold on numbers, not tonnage).
- **New grades / products:** higher grades in welded, seamless tubes; titanium tubes & hygienic tubes (new ventures); tandem JCO press for longer welded pipes (few players can make).
- **Land:** +15 acres adjacent acquired for future expansion.
- **Geographic optionality:** open to US data-center spooling later.
margins & cost:
- FY26 EBITDA margin 16.3% (flat-ish; FY26 EBITDA growth 14% < rev 22% → some margin dilution YoY at FY level).
- RM (SS) prices rose ~5-7% (vs Dec lows ~6-7%); gas shortage a watch item. Prolonged elevated RM "may have some impact going forward."
- Margin levers: spooling (higher value-add/realization), fittings, value-added grades, rising utilization. Target 18% blended by FY28.
capex:
- **Cumulative ~INR200cr+** (seamless+welded+fittings) — now FULLY COMMISSIONED. Asset turn ~3x at full utilization.
- **FY27 capex INR90-100cr:** INR70cr spooling/fabrication facility (fittings machinery, infra) + INR12cr higher-size JCO press (done) + maintenance.
- Seamless expansion scaled up 4,800→6,000 MTPA with matching backward-integration.
capital allocation:
- NWC ~120 days on sales; expected stable in new business.
- EBITDA→CFO conversion 59% (FY26).
- Disciplined FY27 focus: utilization, cash conversion, capital allocation. Further spooling capex possible in 6-12 months if more orders materialize.
risks:
- Middle East conflict → export softness (Q4 export -22% YoY); ME order flow weak.
- RM (SS) price inflation + gas shortage pressuring margins.
- PAT stagnation ~9 quarters (~INR25-26cr) despite heavy capex — execution-on-conversion risk.
- Order book down ~20% YoY (loss of prior BHEL-led peak) — relies on new wins/LOI to hit >20% growth.
- Data-center business commercial only mid-Q3 FY27; single-client LOI concentration.
- Macro slowdown risk in US/Europe (energy inflation) flagged by analyst.
- Welded utilization low (~60-65%).
mgmt tone: Confident and execution-focused; record Q4/FY revenue emphasized. Candid on PAT lag and ME-driven export weakness. Defensive/non-committal on data-center unit economics (per-MW, per-ton — "sold on numbers"). Repeatedly framed >20% growth as conservative-with-upside. Deferred detailed FY27 revenue split to one-on-one calls.
non-obvious:
- Spooling = "PEB for piping" — factory-fabricated pipe+fitting assemblies bolted on-site; reduces site fabrication. Applicable to any SS-pipe-using sector, not just data centers.
- Won DC LOI WITHOUT an existing spooling setup — purely on reputation + welded SKU breadth + new fittings + fast-execution commitment.
- INR185cr LOI from a single data-center operator (not EPC) — DC takes material directly.
- Ratnamani comparison: their spooling is nuclear-focused (~35% EBITDA margin); Venus' is data-center-focused — Venus non-committal on matching 35%. Nuclear has "a lot of limitations" for Venus.
- BHEL fabrication bottleneck easing → faster power-order flow expected; new BHEL tenders open Aug-Sep 2026 (Q2 FY27). BHEL order ~<60% executed in Q4.
- ~20-30% of fittings can be internally pulled into spooling (order-dependent) → two distinct business sets now (pipe+fitting; new-age DC/semicon).
challenges → beneficiaries:
✅ Import-substitution / SS-pipe localization (steel sector MS→SS shift) — Venus direct beneficiary.
⭐ Data-center / AI cooling buildout in India — Venus first-mover among reputed SS pipe players (spooling solution).
⭐ BHEL power capex revival (fabrication bottleneck easing) — Venus L1 INR50cr + future tenders.

---
qoq log: - **Q4 FY26:** Rev INR302.2cr (+17% YoY); EBITDA INR49.4cr (margin 16.3%, +20bps YoY); PAT INR25.4cr (+7%, margin 8.4%). Volume +12-15% YoY, +1-2% QoQ. FY26: Rev INR1,166.8cr (+22%), EBITDA INR190.6cr (+14%, 16.3%), blended EBITDA/ton ~INR65/kg, volume +~15%. Mix S59/W34/O7. Util seamless 90-95%, welded 60-65%. OB INR450cr (+INR185cr DC LOI +INR50cr BHEL L1). Entire INR200cr+ capex commissioned; seamless raised to 6,000 MTPA, 100% backward-integrated (Mother Hollow). New: fittings live, spooling foray (INR70cr, DC, Dec-26), tandem JCO press, +15 acres land. Guidance FY27: >20% rev/vol growth, margin >16.3% → 18% by FY28, capex INR90-100cr, export 30-35%.

themes.title: Data-Center & AI electrical/cooling buildout
themes.need: AI/data-center capex pulls transformers, switchgear, gensets, HVAC/cooling, optical and cabling AND a new high-margin cooling supply chain. CUMMINSIND flags DC at ~30-35% of domestic powergen with a demand surge since Oct-2025; VENUSPIPES won a ~INR185cr DC-cooling LOI; AEROFLEX building liquid-cooling skids; BLUESTARCO on DC MEP; STLTECH/NETWEB on optical + HPC/AI servers (STLTECH's DC+Enterprise mix hit 21% of Q1FY27 revenue from 1% in FY26 on record INR13,100cr quarterly order intake anchored by a $1.1bn multi-year hyperscaler deal; FY27 EBITDA-margin guide raised 20%->23% and DC+Enterprise mix guide raised 30%->50% of revenue); REDINGTON/DCI/IVALUE on GPU/AI-infra distribution. Q1FY27 added two balance-sheet-scale entrants: HCLTECH is putting up to INR 3,500cr into its own AI-datacenter business with a 50MW long-term ambition ('megawatt isn't the product, it's the anchor'), and RELIANCE disclosed a 168 MW Meta data centre at Jamnagar built on its own balance sheet.
themes.driver: DC cooling LOIs converting (VENUSPIPES, AEROFLEX); hyperscaler/colo India capex (CUMMINSIND gensets, BLUESTARCO MEP); STLTECH's $1.1bn hyperscaler optical-connectivity deal and 2.4x QoQ order-book jump to INR18,618cr; GPU/AI-infra orders.

themes.title: Steel tubes & building-materials capex beneficiaries
themes.need: Domestic capex + import-substitution lift value-added steel tubes/pipes and building materials - APLAPOLLO/HITECH/JTLIND/SURYAROSNI/SAMBHV/VENUSPIPES on structural & SS tubes (solar structures, DC cooling, API), FINPIPE/SUPREMEIND/APOLLOPIPE on PVC pipes, MAANALU on aluminium extrusions, RATNAVEER on SS fasteners. A data-center-cooling adjacency adds margin optionality.
themes.driver: Capex commissioning converting to volume; solar-structure & infra demand; commodity pass-through.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Describes itself as a "Manufacturer and Exporter of Stainless-Steel Tubes & Pipes in India" with an "80+ Clientele base out of Fortune 500 Companies in India" and exports to "more than 30+ Countries".
- Claims to be "among the early movers in India's stainless steel pipes and tubes industry to expand beyond pipes and tubes into fittings and spooling, building an integrated portfolio of piping solutions".
- Strategic positioning stated as "Pipes manufacturer to solutions partner" and "From one-of-many to embedded partner", with customer benefits framed as single-window supply for EPCs & OEMs, less interface risk and shorter project lead times.
- End markets span traditional sectors (Chemical, Pharmaceuticals, Paper, Engineering, Power, Oil & Gas, Fertilizers, Food Processing, Aerospace, Heat Exchanger, Nuclear, Automobiles) and "New Age Sectors" named as Data Centers, Solar Manufacturing and Semi Conductors.
- Manufacturing is a single integrated site at Dhaneti (Kutch), described as "Strategically located ... within proximity of Kandla & Mundra ports".

risks.title: Risks
risks.body:
- Middle East conflict → export softness (Q4 export -22% YoY); ME order flow weak.
- RM (SS) price inflation + gas shortage pressuring margins.
- PAT stagnation ~9 quarters (~INR25-26cr) despite heavy capex — execution-on-conversion risk.
- Order book down ~20% YoY (loss of prior BHEL-led peak) — relies on new wins/LOI to hit >20% growth.
- Data-center business commercial only mid-Q3 FY27; single-client LOI concentration.
- Macro slowdown risk in US/Europe (energy inflation) flagged by analyst.
- Welded utilization low (~60-65%).

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious
non_obvious.body:
- Spooling = "PEB for piping" — factory-fabricated pipe+fitting assemblies bolted on-site; reduces site fabrication. Applicable to any SS-pipe-using sector, not just data centers.
- Won DC LOI WITHOUT an existing spooling setup — purely on reputation + welded SKU breadth + new fittings + fast-execution commitment.
- INR185cr LOI from a single data-center operator (not EPC) — DC takes material directly.
- Ratnamani comparison: their spooling is nuclear-focused (~35% EBITDA margin); Venus' is data-center-focused — Venus non-committal on matching 35%. Nuclear has "a lot of limitations" for Venus.
- BHEL fabrication bottleneck easing → faster power-order flow expected; new BHEL tenders open Aug-Sep 2026 (Q2 FY27). BHEL order ~<60% executed in Q4.
- ~20-30% of fittings can be internally pulled into spooling (order-dependent) → two distinct business sets now (pipe+fitting; new-age DC/semicon).

challenges.title: Challenges → Beneficiaries
challenges.body:
✅ Import-substitution / SS-pipe localization (steel sector MS→SS shift) — Venus direct beneficiary.
⭐ Data-center / AI cooling buildout in India — Venus first-mover among reputed SS pipe players (spooling solution).
⭐ BHEL power capex revival (fabrication bottleneck easing) — Venus L1 INR50cr + future tenders.

---

qoq_log.title: QoQ Log
qoq_log.body: - **Q4 FY26:** Rev INR302.2cr (+17% YoY); EBITDA INR49.4cr (margin 16.3%, +20bps YoY); PAT INR25.4cr (+7%, margin 8.4%). Volume +12-15% YoY, +1-2% QoQ. FY26: Rev INR1,166.8cr (+22%), EBITDA INR190.6cr (+14%, 16.3%), blended EBITDA/ton ~INR65/kg, volume +~15%. Mix S59/W34/O7. Util seamless 90-95%, welded 60-65%. OB INR450cr (+INR185cr DC LOI +INR50cr BHEL L1). Entire INR200cr+ capex commissioned; seamless raised to 6,000 MTPA, 100% backward-integrated (Mother Hollow). New: fittings live, spooling foray (INR70cr, DC, Dec-26), tandem JCO press, +15 acres land. Guidance FY27: >20% rev/vol growth, margin >16.3% → 18% by FY28, capex INR90-100cr, export 30-35%.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Order book] The FY23-FY26 comparison slide states the order book "Increased ~2.5 times to INR 450 Crores" over the same period in which revenue "Grew by 28% CAGR to INR 1,167 Crores" and exports "Increased ~13 times to INR 400 Crores".
- [Export risk] MD flags the two external watch items explicitly: "On the export front, the geopolitical situation remains an area of watch. In addition, freight rates continue to remain a factor that we are monitoring closely."
- [Governance] Board and management include Arun Kothari (Chairman & MD, CA), two founder-era Whole Time Directors (Jayantiram M Choudhary, Megharam S Choudhary), Dhruv M Patel (WTD), CFO Kunal Bubna and President-Marketing Kumar Shishir C Sinha (34 years in stainless-steel pipes and tubes).
